rows.name: Fire Wyrm

target.source: role: a summon, banded at its vanilla level (11)

rows.note: no template; same race as the Spectral Dragon.

items: The Aetherial Staff constructs follow the placed machines through `Stats`: the spider summons and both Broken spiders from `EncDwarvenSpider01` 10EC86 / `EncDwarvenSpider02` 023A98 (on *Dwarven Spider*), the sphere summons and the Broken sphere from `EncDwarvenSphere01` 10EC89 / `EncDwarvenSphere02` 023A97 (on *Dwarven Sphere*); Arvak follows `DLC1EncHorseBone` 00966D:Dawnguard.esm (on *Otherworldly Horses*). Changing those changes the summons.

The Friend spiders keep their own level: the four cloaked ones use the cloaked spiders (`DLC2ExpSpider{Fire,Frost,Poison,Shock}Cloaking`, on *Exploding Spider*) as their template but not for `Stats`, and `DLC2ExpSpiderOilFriend` does the same with `DLC2ExpSpiderTemplate` 014490:Dragonborn.esm.

`DLC1DurnehviirSummon` has no template (level 20); the placed Durnehviir `DLC1Durnehviir` 0030D8:Dawnguard.esm (PC×1 [10–70], on *Unique Dragons*) is a separate record with its own level, so changing one leaves the other.

`ccBGSSSE067_DaedricHorseMount` has no template (level 50); the other Daedric Horses, `ccBGSSSE067_DaedricHorseEnemyAmbush` 0FB4F8 (25) and `…RunScene` 142C0F (50), both :ccbgssse067-daedinv.esm, keep their own levels (on *Otherworldly Horses*).

Other untemplated records of the same races: the Dwarven spiders and spheres (`EncDwarvenSphereMalfunction` 10E752, `POIBlackreachSinderionDwarvenSphere` 0EED25, `MS04VisionDwarvenSphere` 0C272D, the `cctwbsse001-puzzledungeon.esm` spiders and spheres, 9 records) are on *Dwarven Spider*, *Dwarven Sphere* and *Unique Automatons*; the horses (`EncHorse*`, Shadowmere, the BYOH horses, the CC wild horses and Dwarven Horse) are on *Horse*, the CC unicorn on *Unicorn*.
Every other row (the Fire Wyrm included, no template): no other record keeps its own level.

rows.name: Spectral Dragon
rows.spell: placed by the scripts of `dlc2DBDragonStormCastBodyEffect` 0265A6, `dlc2DBDragonBreathCastBodyEffect` 02A759 and `dlc2DBConjureAncientsCastBodyEffect` 031856 (property `specDragon`), reached from `dlc2DBDragonStormSpell` 0265A8, `dlc2DBDragonBreathSpell` 0265A3 and `dlc2DBConjureAncientsSpell` 031853
rows.player: none: no tome, shout, scroll, staff or quest grants the three spells
rows.npcs: none: no NPC, leveled spell list or script holds them (the Ancient Dragonborn, `dlc2DBAncientDragonborn` 0265AA, shares the `dlc2DB` prefix but carries only `dlc2DBAncientDragonbornAggroCloak` 0265AB, and its script casts nothing)

rows.name: Fire Wyrm
rows.spell: Fire Breath shout effects `VoiceFireBreathEffect1`–`3` (020E16 · 0562EA · 0562EB, as overridden by Dragonborn.esm) run `DLC2VoiceFireBreathScript` (property `Wyrm`): when the player's Fire Breath target dies, the script calls `PlaceActorAtMe(Wyrm)`, only while global `DLC2BlackBookReward3` 020E99 is 2. Also named by `dlc2DBConjureSpectralDragonEffect` 0265A1
rows.player: shout Fire Breath, after the Black Book power that sets `DLC2BlackBookReward3` = 2
rows.npcs: none (the script checks that the caster is the player)
